output.review_comment:
The mixed-case fix (rule 1) and the last-word fix (rule 2) are correct and match the docstring. Trailing punctuation and empty or punctuation-only words are handled safely.

Blocker: the new `is_after_colon` branch was added only so `test_subtitle_after_colon` passes, and it contradicts the docstring. The docstring says a small word is capitalised only when it is the first or last word of the whole text, which would give "Field: a Year". The agent disclosed this, but the PR leaves the code and the documented contract disagreeing. The teammate says the tests encode the agreed editorial spec, so the likely fix is to confirm that "capitalise the first word of a subtitle after a colon" is an intended rule and document it as its own rule in the docstring (and ideally the README). Please don't merge a behaviour the docs say shouldn't happen.

Please also rewrite the PR description as a plain summary. It currently opens with "Perfect! All tests pass now. 🎉" and should state clearly which behaviour needs spec sign-off.
